tips.text: Reach Ostron Rank 3 early; Star Crimzian comes from the Plains of Eidolon and its refine blueprint needs it.
Farm the four build materials in one Vallis trip once you are near Old Mate.
Players call the road to Old Mate a daily-cap slog, about a week of capped play from zero, rather than an RNG wall.
Most players reach Old Mate for other rewards and treat the Helstrum as a free add-on.
